modules.title: Fluid Mechanics II
modules.summary: Builds on fluid mechanics to analyse more advanced flow behaviour relevant to mechanical systems.
modules.sourceLocator: 2026 EBE Senate Rules, Mechanical Engineering, Year of Study III; printed p. 52; syllabus entry MECN3071A
modules.activityNote: KAIRO-authored enrichment mapping: use the pump model to connect fluid-flow concepts with an illustrative system. This is not represented as a Wits-prescribed activity.

modules.title: Thermodynamics II
modules.summary: Extends thermodynamics concepts for analysis of mechanical energy systems.
modules.sourceLocator: 2026 EBE Senate Rules, Mechanical Engineering, Year of Study III; printed p. 52; syllabus entry MECN3077A
modules.activityNote: KAIRO reading enrichment: source-grounded explanatory material; no specific prescribed exercise is claimed.

modules.title: Mechatronics II
modules.summary: Introduces a systems approach to analysing and designing integrated mechatronic systems, with practical laboratory and project experience described in the syllabus.
modules.sourceLocator: 2026 EBE Syllabuses, MECN3066A; 2026 EBE Senate Rules, Mechanical Engineering, Year of Study III course list
modules.activityNote: KAIRO-authored enrichment mapping: explore the existing motor model and speed calculation as an illustrative electromechanical system; not a university-assigned lab or project.

modules.title: Engineering Tools II

modules.activityNote: KAIRO-authored reading enrichment about model assumptions and interpretation; no curriculum exercise or numerical solver is implied.

modules.title: Mechanical Engineering Investigation
modules.summary: Develops the ability to plan and conduct mechanical engineering investigations, evaluate results, and communicate findings.
modules.sourceLocator: 2026 EBE Syllabuses, MECN3079A; 2026 EBE Senate Rules, Mechanical Engineering, Year of Study III course list
modules.activityNote: KAIRO-authored enrichment: review evidence and distinguish source claims from interpretation; this does not satisfy or reproduce a Wits investigation.

modules.title: Mechanical Engineering Design
modules.summary: Applies mechanical engineering design methods to develop and assess engineering solutions.
modules.sourceLocator: 2026 EBE Syllabuses, MECN3080A; 2026 EBE Senate Rules, Mechanical Engineering, Year of Study III course list

sources.title: 2026 Senate Rules and Syllabuses for the Faculty of Engineering and the Built Environment

limits: Illustrative public-curriculum selection for a coherent third-year Mechanical Engineering space, not an enrolment record, transcript, complete curriculum, Wits integration, endorsement, or claim of learner attainment. The course finder establishes year-level listing; the 2026 EBE rules establish official course codes and year grouping. Semester fields are null because the inspected course-level material did not verify semester placement for every selected course. KAIRO activity labels are authored enrichment mappings; the university sources do not prescribe the linked motor or pump studio interactions. Wits source text is summarized in original wording; no syllabus prose is reproduced. Source documents are publicly accessible, but their reuse/licensing terms were not verified; links and factual metadata only are included.
